title: Austin Street Upkeep & Rail Transit Plans
summary:
*   **Austin's Road Condition & Upkeep:** City staff provided an update and discussed plans for maintaining Austin's street infrastructure.
*   **Light Rail Transit Proposal:** Capital Metro presented a detailed briefing on the potential for a new light rail system in Austin, covering its benefits, possible routes, funding, and development.
*   **Future Transportation Planning:** This special meeting was dedicated to in-depth discussions on critical infrastructure, focusing on both existing road networks and exploring a new rail transit option for the city.

SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
TOWN LAKE CENTER 1:30 Ρ.Μ.
The Special Called Meeting of the Council began at 1:37 Ρ.Μ.
Councilmembers Larson, Reynolds and Epstein were the only members of the Council present
at that time. Councilmember Larson called the meeting to order and stated the purpose of
the meeting was to hold a worksession on 1. Street Infrastructure Maintenance; and 2.
Briefing by Capital Metro on Light Rail.
Bill Stockton, Director of Public Works and Transportation, began his report on Street
Infrastructure Maintenance. During Mr.
Stockton's presentation, Councilmembers Nofziger, Garcia and Mayor Todd entered the room,
and the meeting of the Council became official with a quorum present.
Mr. Stockton's Maintenance Report, which was illustrated with slides, is on file in the
City Clerk's Office.
The Briefing by Capital Metro on Light Rail, was introduced by Tony Kouneski. He, in turn,
introduced Cecelia Kupersmith, General Manager, and Jim Robertson, Light Rail Coordinator,
who continued th presentation. Mr. Robinson discussed the benefits, efficiency, and
effectiveness of light rail, highlighting his remarks with slides of other city's light
rail systems. Mr. Kouneski discussed options, placement of the rail, funding, development,
right-of-way issues, long term development and fares.
Council asked questions of both the Capital Metro staff, and members of the Capital Metro
Board who were present.
The meeting was adjourned at 4:22 Ρ.Μ.
